entries.description: POST /api/contact on armands.site – sends a message from a website visitor to the site owner via the Cloudflare Worker + Zoho Mail. JSON body: name, email, message. Turnstile-verified. Useful for agents that need to reach the owner of the armands.* sites.
representativeQueries: How can I contact the owner of this website?
Send a message to the site administrator
What is the contact endpoint of armands.site?
